create_datatype_check_numeric: create a DataType instance and test if it is numeric using the is_numeric class method
build_datatype_from_python: build a Polars DataType from a Python type using the from_python class method
create_categorical_categories: create a Categories instance with a custom name and namespace for categorical data encoding
create_enum_from_strings: create an Enum DataType from a unique set of string categories for fixed categorical encoding
build_struct_with_fields: build a Struct DataType from a mapping of field names to their Polars data types
